seed.name: Future Lines of Demarcation Backtest Strategy

source_semantics.core: FLD = src; pos=+1 if src[t-Period] < close[t], pos=-1 if src[t-Period] > close[t], otherwise persist previous state
source_semantics.plot_offset: visual only; offset=Period does not make future information available

algebraic_collision.close_source: pos = sign(close[t]-close[t-Period]) except equality persistence; this is the sign of a lagged close return and introduces no new causal operator
algebraic_collision.other_ohlc_sources: replace the lagged close reference with lagged hl2/high/low/open/hlc3/hlcc4/ohlc4; these are same-source lagged-reference profiles, not a distinct information source
algebraic_collision.reverse: BUY/SELL inversion is explicitly non-novel under QROS policy
algebraic_collision.period: changing Period is a window mutation and cannot create independent alpha

prior_operator_evidence.policy: QROS_SCIENTIFIC_FASTLANE_AND_FRONTIER_REOPEN_v1 prohibits new window/threshold/monotonic-transform variants as new genealogies

reason: The exact source does not provide causal-operator novelty. Building a detailed universe would violate the frozen collision policy and inflate multiplicity.
